shellCommands.command: echo "--- app ---"; ls -la app; echo "--- lib ---"; ls -la lib; echo "--- next.config.ts ---"; cat next.config.ts; echo "--- tsconfig ---"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "--- agent_eval ---"; ls -la __agent_eval__; cat __agent_eval__/* 2>/dev/null

cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "---"; grep -rl "updateTag" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---cache exports---"; find node_modules/next/dist -maxdepth 2 -iname "*cache*"; echo "---server exports index---"; cat node_modules/next/cache.js 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls node_modules/next/ | grep -i cache

grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---experimental use cache---"; grep -rn "useCache\b" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---search dynamicIO---"; grep -rn "dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
find node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache -iname "*.js" | xargs grep -l "profiles\|cacheLife" | head; echo "---"; cat node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life.js 2>/dev/null | head -100
(npm run dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE '(Laptop|Phone|Tablet|Headphones|Watch|Sync latest catalog)'
git status; echo "---diff---"; git diff -- next.config.ts lib/db.js app/page.tsx
cat .gitignore; echo "---"; git check-ignore -v .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo package-lock.json 2>&1
ls -la AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 2>&1; echo "---"; head -5 AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md 2>&1
